rights_note: Project Runeberg states that it normally publishes Nordic literary works after copyright has expired under a life-plus-70 rule, and that copyright-protected Runeberg editions display an explicit warning; no such warning appears on this Fröken Julie edition. August Strindberg died in 1912. Independently, Australian Copyright Agency guidance states that published text is out of copyright in Australia when it was published before 1955 and the creator died before 1955. Fröken Julie was published in 1888 and Strindberg died in 1912, so the underlying literary work is out of copyright in Australia.
